anomaly_signals.detail: 109 errors out of 520 spans — ~21% error rate, the single largest error contributor in the batch. Strongly consistent with an active memory_incident scenario.

48 errors out of 530 spans (~9.1% error rate) alongside 53 genai_tool_failures globally. Tool execution is severely degraded, likely downstream of memory-service failures affecting agent context retrieval.
40 errors out of 520 spans (~7.7% error rate). Agents are failing at an elevated rate, consistent with cascading failures from memory-service and tool-executor.

21 errors out of 260 spans (~8.1% error rate). p99 latency across the stack is 31,730 ms — over 31 seconds — pointing to orchestration stalls, likely due to retries or timeouts waiting on degraded memory/tool services.
13 errors out of 893 spans and 28 token truncation events globally. Truncations may indicate oversized context payloads being constructed due to memory-service returning partial or corrupt data.

14 errors out of 402 spans (~3.5% error rate), echoed by 3 postgres-payments errors. Payments flow is experiencing elevated failures, possibly due to workflow orchestration delays or agent failures impacting payment steps.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate and restart/isolate memory-service pods — it is the epicentre of the incident with a ~21% error rate. Check memory-service logs for OOM events, connection pool exhaustion, or backing store failures. Verify tool-executor and agent-service recover once memory-service stabilises. Review the 28 LLM token truncations for context-size anomalies that may indicate corrupted memory retrievals inflating prompt payloads. Consider enabling circuit-breakers on memory-service dependencies to prevent further cascading into payments and workflow flows.
summary: An active memory_incident is causing a cascading failure across the stack: memory-service is erroring on ~21% of its spans, directly triggering elevated failures in tool-executor (~9%), agent-service (~7.7%), and workflow-orchestrator (~8.1%). The p99 latency has blown out to over 31.7 seconds, and 53 tool failures plus 28 LLM token truncations indicate significant GenAI pipeline degradation across the board.
